faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our premium European parquet

delays.question: What are the delivery times?
delays.answer:
Our lead times vary by product type:

• Standard: 2 weeks
• First choice: 3 to 4 weeks
• Custom: 6 to 8 weeks

These times apply from order confirmation.

zones.question: Where do you deliver?
zones.answer:
We deliver throughout Europe, including:

• France (mainland)
• Germany
• Belgium
• Switzerland
• Luxembourg

Delivery is by full pallets via our logistics partner.

shipping.question: How does delivery work?
shipping.answer: Delivery is made by specialized pallet carrier. The driver will contact you to arrange a time slot. Please ensure suitable access (pallet jack recommended) or manual unloading possible with assistance.

origin.question: Where do your parquets come from?
origin.answer: Our parquets are manufactured in Europe (Poland) from oak and ash sourced from certified European forests. We prioritize short supply chains and complete wood traceability.

heating.question: Are your parquets compatible with underfloor heating?
heating.answer: Yes, our engineered parquets are perfectly compatible with low-temperature underfloor heating (max 28°C surface). Solid parquet is not recommended for underfloor heating.

samples.question: Can I receive samples?
samples.answer: Absolutely! Contact us via the form to receive samples of our different species and finishes. Free service for professionals.

minimum.question: Is there a minimum order?
minimum.answer: To optimize shipping costs, we recommend a minimum order of 30 m². For smaller orders, additional shipping fees may apply.

quote.question: How do I get a quote?
quote.answer: Fill out our contact form specifying the desired product and estimated area. We'll send you a detailed quote within 24-48 hours.

payment.question: What are the payment terms?
payment.answer: 30% deposit on order, balance on delivery. Bank transfer or SEPA direct debit. Special terms for professional partners.

partner.question: How do I become a Natura Parquet partner?
partner.answer: Visit our 'Become a Partner' page and fill out the application form. We review each request and get back to you within 48 hours to discuss partnership terms.

prices.question: Do you offer professional pricing?
prices.answer: Yes, we offer attractive terms for professionals (resellers, craftsmen, architects). Volume-based pricing and possibility of territorial exclusivity. Contact us to discuss.
